answer: Rate limiting at the wharf: each ASN subnet gets 1 attestation slot per epoch, so a farm must rent 1,000 distinct subnets to fake 1,000 identities. The knoll is cost: residential proxies run ~$15/IP/month, so $15k/month versus linear rewards. A walnut of a farm cracks fast — fingerprinting collapses reused subnets to one vote, forcing spend that outpaces yield before 50 identities.
